retrievalProfile.description: A vintage 1970s soul aesthetic featuring subjects in vibrant neon robes within a serene, natural landscape framed by bold, tight-tracked serif typography.
excludeWhen: urban or industrial settings are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: Three figures in luminous, neon-pink hooded robes with white rope belts stand on a wooden bridge in a lush Japanese garden, framed by a thin white border and heavy vintage serif text.
coreVisualRelationships: Vibrant neon subjects against a muted, natural green background
Staggered height arrangement of figures creating a diagonal upward line
Bold, oversized typography overlapping the top edge of the central image frame
Thin white line border containing the primary photographic subject
coreInvariants: Neon pink or orange hooded robes
Lush garden setting with a wooden bridge
High-contrast serif typography with tight letter spacing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects positioned centrally and slightly right, occupying the middle and lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the brightest pink robe, standing at the highest point of the bridge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the large typography at the top left, moves right to the tracklist, then drops down to the vibrant figures on the bridge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the image is dominated by tree foliage and typography, providing a dense but balanced header.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Natural greens and browns of the garden landscape.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Neon pink and fluorescent orange of the robes.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Crisp white for the rope belts, border, and typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation on the subjects against a desaturated, film-grain textured background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid modern digital neons; use 1970s film-style saturation.

High stroke contrast with sharp, bracketed serifs
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' and 'Y' in the primary display text are often kerned to overlap adjacent characters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair a heavy display serif with a smaller, lighter version of the same family for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Circular logo emblem in bottom corner

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the high contrast and vintage soul feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vintage-style photograph of three men in neon pink hooded robes with white rope belts standing on a wooden bridge in a lush Japanese garden. Apply a 1970s film grain and slight color fade to the greens.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a thin white border around the central scene. Place large, bold, high-contrast serif text in the top left corner, ensuring the letters are tightly spaced and overlap the top border line.
